input_json.description: Absolute path to a Protenix-format input JSON describing the molecular system (chains, ligands, optional MSA/template hints).

candidates.$comment: Canonical Candidate v1 input accepted additively; see src/vibeproteinagent/schemas/candidate_v1.json.
candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from upstream sequence-producing tools. Promotes the first item's `sequence` into a generated Protenix input JSON when `input_json` is omitted.

seeds.description: List of integer RNG seeds. Protenix runs one prediction per seed; multiple seeds yield independent diffusion samples for confidence estimation.

use_msa.description: Enable multiple-sequence-alignment features for protein chains. Improves accuracy but requires a precomputed MSA or remote MSA generation.

msa_backend.description: MSA backend policy. With `use_msa=true`, `auto` uses a prepared MSA if present and otherwise falls back to remote generation; `none` disables MSA; `remote` always calls the remote MSA path.

use_template.description: Use template structures during prediction. Templates must be present in the input JSON or fetched via Protenix's template pipeline.

use_rna_msa.description: Include RNA MSA features when the system contains RNA chains.

enable_cache.description: Cache diffusion state tensors during inference to speed up multi-seed runs. Disable only when debugging or under memory pressure.

enable_tf32.description: Allow TF32 tensor operations on NVIDIA Ampere+ GPUs (faster, slightly lower precision).

n_sample.description: Number of diffusion samples per seed. Increasing yields more candidate structures at proportional GPU cost.

n_step.description: Diffusion sampling steps per sample. Higher values improve structure quality at higher cost.

n_cycle.description: AR-flow recycle count. Analogous to AF2 recycles: more cycles improve quality with diminishing returns.
